system_context.mission: Ship a real, sustainable mobile product spun out of WARDEN — a hackathon submission (Shipaton) is opportunistic, not the driver.
constraints: Shipaton requires RevenueCat SDK integration on a supported mobile framework (native, React Native, Kotlin Multiplatform, Flutter, or Expo).
WARDEN's broker-scan crawling requires real browser automation (Playwright) against 44 external sites — cannot run on-device.
Prior judged round explicitly penalized CORTEGE for scope that was too broad and unclear.
governing_rules_locked_so_far: Backend: extend the existing CORTEGE Node server rather than extracting or rebuilding
MVP scope: free scan + paid continuous re-scan/monitoring for broker exposure; automated removal filing and family plan tier deferred past v1

user_context.stakeholder: Taylor Parsons — building this as a genuine product decision, not a scramble to a hackathon deadline. Comfortable with technical tradeoffs; prefers direct, concise collaboration over exhaustive option surveys.
user_context.new_signal: Introduced a 'must run locally on the phone using a local model' requirement mid-brainstorm. Motivation not yet stated explicitly (likely privacy and/or differentiation) and target feature is ambiguous — could mean the broker-scan app's analysis layer, or a return to CORTEGE's original on-device scam/fraud triage concept (ANCHOR/SENTINEL/SCOUT).

tool_context.execution_environment: Expo / React Native mobile app talking to the existing CORTEGE Node server.
on_device_inference_assumptions: iOS: Apple's on-device Foundation Models framework (newer OS/hardware only).
Android: Gemini Nano via AICore (largely flagship-only hardware; broad fragmentation risk).
Cross-platform alternative: bundled small model via llama.cpp/GGUF or MLX bridge, trading consistency for app size and eval burden.
tool_context.open_question_for_brainstorm: Which specific feature the local-model requirement applies to must be resolved before continuing the architectural design — it changes the backend/data-flow design materially depending on the answer.
